title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod pack in Blue Razz Lemonade brings a perfect combination of rich blue raspberry sweetness and a zesty lemonade twist, delivering a bold and refreshing vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, offering extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. The pods are equipped with advanced dual mesh coil technology, ensuring smooth, consistent flavour and rich, dense vapour production. With an innovative automatic refill system and leak-resistant design, refilling your pod is quick, easy, and hassle-free. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs of vibrant Crystal flavour, making it perfect for vapers seeking an effortless yet flavour-packed and long-lasting experience. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for both seasoned and newer adult vapers. Simply replace the used pod and refill container when empty to enjoy uninterrupted, flavourful vaping.
